name: Charles Sturt Student Emergency Equity Grant
summary: One-off grant for Charles Sturt students facing sudden financial hardship, for domestic and international students.
key: The amount is determined by the Scholarships and Financial Support team through the assessment process.
who: Currently studying an undergraduate or postgraduate course at Charles Sturt
Enrolled in one or more subjects in the current session
Completed at least one session of study, or enrolled after the census date of your first session
Able to show financial hardship with supporting documents
how: Complete the online application form and attach supporting documents
catches: One grant per study session; funding is limited
Applications with incorrect or no supporting documentation are deemed ineligible

source.label: Charles Sturt University: Student Emergency Equity Grant

evidence.quote: The amount is determined by the Scholarships and Financial Support team through the assessment process

evidence.claim: Open to domestic and international students
evidence.quote: The Emergency Equity Grant is available to both domestic and international students.
